career_overview.short_description: Build complete, end-to-end web applications combining interactive user interfaces, server-side APIs, and databases.
responsibilities: Develop responsive frontend interfaces and bind them to server-side APIs
Design relational data models and implement transactional database queries
Build secure full-stack authentication, session handling, and authorization flows
Leverage server-side rendering (SSR) frameworks for performant web delivery
Write end-to-end automated tests and deploy containerized full-stack services
representative_work: A full-stack web application with user authentication, responsive UI components, REST/GraphQL API endpoints, database persistence, and automated end-to-end tests.
core_skills: End-to-end authentication with cookies and JWTs
Automated testing with Playwright or Cypress

roadmap.title: Full Stack Developer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A full-stack web application with user authentication, responsive UI components, REST/GraphQL API endpoints, database persistence, and automated end-to-end tests.
